meta.name: Tougen Anki
meta.description: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

videos.title: Oni's Blood
videos.overview: Teenager Shiki is attacked by a mysterious man. As his foster father Tsuyoshi helps him flee, he learns of his surprising and legendary heritage.

videos.title: If You Want to Make It, Keep On Winning
videos.overview: Shiki wakes up confused in front of Naito, who explains the situation between the Oni and the Momotaro.

videos.title: Blood Eclipse Release
videos.overview: The first test the boys face to enter the academy is playing "demon catcher."

videos.title: Work with Me
videos.overview: If they want to pass the test their teacher has given them, students must work together.

videos.title: Bad News
videos.overview: The students reach the Kyoto underground and discover new things about the war they are involved in.

videos.title: Even the Loner Path Has Its Limits
videos.overview: The undead attack the students and Shiki is forced to make a decision that will change his mind.

videos.title: The Beauty is a Beast
videos.overview: Yomogi uses his power to seal off the underground and the students must fight to survive.

videos.title: The Unreliable Hero
videos.overview: Kuina fights a battle against another ugly, but this time he finds himself in a very delicate situation.

videos.title: Momotaro Spirit
videos.overview: The riots affect the security of the temple and the students must evacuate the people as soon as possible.

videos.title: Kishin's Child
videos.overview: Samidare visits the Momotaro headquarters in Tokyo. Brushing off fellow agent Shinya's provocations, he declares he will be the one to kill Shiki.

videos.title: Thank You!
videos.overview: Overwhelmed by Shiki's intense flames, a wounded Tsubakiri recalls the promise he made to his mentor, Manaka — the man whose corpse he controls.

videos.title: Day of the Storm
videos.overview: A storm catches the boys by surprise and they have to stay locked up for a night.

videos.title: Mikado, Like Gate of the Gods
videos.overview: The boys have time to go to a local festival and Shiki meets someone mysterious.

videos.title: Personal Rule
videos.overview: Momotaro's surveillance network detects what happened in the city center and responds immediately.

videos.title: Found You
videos.overview: Shinya is looking for the academy students to carry out the plan he has in mind.

videos.title: Not So Bad
videos.overview: A kidnapping, a hostage, and a secret plan intertwine in an attempt to find Shiki's whereabouts.

videos.title: The Vengeful Oni
videos.overview: Jin reminisces about everything he experienced during his childhood.

videos.title: Haunted by Doubt
videos.overview: The squadrons are set in motion as doubts creep in about what's coming.

videos.title: The Voice of the Weak
videos.overview: Mikado meets Shiki and reveals who he is, but Shiki doesn't know why he knows his name or what he's plotting.

videos.title: Rage vs. Rage
videos.overview: After awakening as an Oni, Shiki Ichinose must master his power and join the age-old war against the Momotaro.

videos.title: Flawless Fortune
videos.overview: The tarot cards and their position can tip the balance of the fight one way or the other.

videos.title: A Futile Battle
videos.overview: During the battle, Shinya remembers his past and what motivated him to aspire to get where he is today.

videos.title: My Friend
videos.overview: After awakening as an Oni, Shiki Ichinose must master his power and join the age-old war against the Momotaro.

videos.title: Until We Meet Again
videos.overview: After the battle, everyone must re-evaluate their destiny and the next steps that need to be taken.

videos.title: Let the Training Begin
videos.overview: The students must climb a mountain within 24 hours during a blizzard, dodging two rival professors.

videos.title: The Path to Growing Strong
videos.overview: Shiki is caught in an avalanche while shielding Homare, who has injured her leg.

videos.title: Purpose
videos.overview: Homare and Shiki reach the summit, followed by Juji, Kuina, and Rokuro. Only Jin and Yaoroshi remain. As Yaoroshi lashes out at those around him, Jin points out that his impatience is causing trouble for his teammates. Just then, Nekosaki and Innami appear.

videos.title: Child of Kishin: Hayate Todoroki
videos.overview: The Oni Brigade operates independently, fighting the Momotaro without answering to any organization. Its general, Hayate Todoroki, arrives at Rasetsu Academy to recruit Shiki, a Child of Kishin. Shiki rejects Todoroki's invitation to join his campaign to wipe out the Momotaro, but Yaoroshi sympathizes with his cause and leaves with him.

videos.title: New Blood
videos.overview: Hayate brings Yaoroshi to meet the other members of the Oni Brigade. Having raided Momotaro bases across the country, the group now sets its sights on a laboratory built where Kegon Falls once stood. Though fewer than ten strong, they are undaunted by the hundreds of enemies they expect to face.

videos.title: Out of Focus
videos.overview: At 2:00 a.m., the Oni Brigade infiltrates the laboratory built on the former site of Kegon Falls. Staying in contact through Otohara's ability, Sharing, the members split up. Yaoroshi heads to the fourth floor with Todoroki and Umitsuki, but finds himself disturbed by Todoroki's willingness to kill noncombatants without hesitation.

videos.title: The General's Back
videos.overview: As he battles Shingi, Torikai recalls his first meeting with Todoroki, General of the Oni Brigade. He is determined to win for the man who saved his life and gave him a reason to live. Bleeding heavily from Shingi's attacks, Torikai watches for a chance to turn the tables.

videos.title: One's Own Way
videos.overview: By the time Shiki and the others arrive at Kegon Falls, the Oni Brigade has already begun its assault. With no time to wait for reinforcements, they charge into the laboratory alongside Enomoto. Meanwhile, Kusabi spots Mudano and Shiki through his surveillance drone, delighted that such ideal specimens have come to him.

videos.title: Mix Live
videos.overview: As Shiki and his friends charge the lab, they are met by the captains and vice-captains of the Fifth, Sixth, and Sevent Units, along with a large force of Momotaro troops. Mudano stops the soldiers in their tracks with his killing intent alone and takes on all six officers, sending the others ahead.
